app.name: Shift Planner
app.tagline: Plan next month's shifts in minutes.

stepDescriptions.store: Opening hours, special dates and how many people you need.
stepDescriptions.employees: Your team, their contracts and hour balances.
stepDescriptions.availability: When people can't work, and when they'd prefer to.
stepDescriptions.generate: Let the planner find the best schedule.
stepDescriptions.plan: Review and fine-tune the schedule by hand.
stepDescriptions.export: Print it or open it in a spreadsheet.
stepDescriptions.advanced: Every rule and weight. Optional – the defaults work well.

empty.comingSoonBody: This step is part of an upcoming release.

project.newDescription: Choose the month you want to plan.
project.replaceDescription: Your current plan will be replaced. Save it first if you want to keep a copy.

welcome.title: Plan next month's shifts
welcome.subtitle: Enter your opening hours, your team and their wishes. Shift Planner finds a plan that follows the rules, and you can fine-tune it by hand.
welcome.newDescription: Begin with sensible defaults for the month you choose.
welcome.demoDescription: A fictional team of 9 people with availability and wishes, ready to plan.
welcome.openDescription: Continue from a .json file you saved earlier.
welcome.privacy: Your data stays in this browser. The server only uses it to calculate the plan and stores nothing.

errors.offline: Can't reach the planning service. Check that it is running and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.fileNotJson: This file isn't a Shift Planner project.
errors.restoreFailed: Your autosaved plan couldn't be restored. A backup copy was kept in this browser.

project.missingSchemaVersion: This file isn't a Shift Planner project (no format version found).
project.newerSchemaVersion: This file was saved by a newer version of Shift Planner (format {{version}}; this app supports up to {{supported}}).
project.noMigration: This file uses format {{version}}, which can't be upgraded automatically.
project.invalid_one: This project file has {{count}} problem and can't be opened.
project.invalid_other: This project file has {{count}} problems and can't be opened.

store.name: Store name
store.hoursDescription: When customers can shop. Staff are planned from before opening until after closing.
store.closesBeforeOpens: Closing time must be after opening time.
store.beforeHelp: Minutes of work before the doors open.
store.afterHelp: Minutes of work after the doors close.
store.specialDescription: Public holidays use the holiday hours. Turn on special hours to close early, open late, or close for the day.
store.noSpecialDates: No public holidays this month. Add a date below to give it special hours.
store.staffingDescription: The minimum number of people at the start and end of each day. The planner takes care of the rest.
store.allowAloneHelp: When off, at least 2 people are present whenever the store is staffed.
store.dailyHelp: Opening and closing count from when staff arrive and leave. Daily hours are optional; leave them empty for no target.
store.rangesDescription: Extra minimums for part of the day, e.g. at least 2 people 11:00–14:00 on Saturdays.
store.rangeInvalid: Pick at least one day type, and an end time after the start time.
